findings.title: Boolean conversion of receipt may not reflect acceptance status
findings.body: what changed: The function now returns `bool(receipt)` instead of `receipt.accepted`. how it differs from earlier similar changes in this file: The previous version explicitly checked the `accepted` attribute, which is clear and direct. why it was done that way: Unclear, possibly to reduce code. what breaks: If `PublishReceipt` does not define `__bool__` to return the acceptance status, the function may return an incorrect value (e.g., always True for non-None receipts). what to do: Revert to `return receipt.accepted` or ensure `PublishReceipt.__bool__` returns the acceptance status and document it.

summary.problem: The function `was_accepted` now relies on the truthiness of the `PublishReceipt` object, which may not correctly reflect the acceptance status.
summary.done_well: The function remains short and focused on a single responsibility.
